hypotheses.G1_individual_edge_effects_are_approxima: Summed individual-edge logit effects have at least 0.90 mean Fisher fidelity to the full finite message effect.
hypotheses.G2_sixteen_cooperative_edges_are_useful: Cooperative top-16 programs have at least 0.80 mean exact finite Fisher fidelity.
hypotheses.G3_thirtytwo_cooperative_edges_are_robus: Cooperative top-32 programs have at least 0.75 exact fidelity in every condition.
hypotheses.G4_cooperative_selection_beats_state_nor: At budget 16, cooperative selection exceeds state-norm selection by at least 0.10 mean fidelity.
hypotheses.G5_cooperative_selection_beats_oneshot_g: At budget 16, cooperative selection exceeds one-shot Fisher-gain ranking by at least 0.05 mean fidelity.
hypotheses.G6_cooperative_frontier_is_monotone: Mean exact cooperative fidelity is nondecreasing across all tested budgets.
hypotheses.G7_linear_gram_prediction_tracks_finite_: Linearized-Gram and exact finite cooperative fidelities correlate at least 0.90 across condition-budget rows.
hypotheses.G8_cooperative_program_uses_both_signs: At least ten percent of the first sixteen cooperatively selected edges have negative initial target cross-score.
hypotheses.G9_thirtytwo_edges_are_nearly_sufficient: Cooperative top-32 programs have at least 0.90 mean exact fidelity.
hypotheses.G10_no_fixed_source_skeleton_explains_th: The sixteen most frequent cooperative top-16 positions account for less than half of selections.
